purpose: Teach: 日差し/柔らかく/一度に/親しい/半日/体温/倒れる/別れる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の日差し、午後はちょうどいいね。
lines.en: The afternoon sun on the garden is just right, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet, settling tone. Long pause on the dash as he gazes. Slow, even pace. The voice of someone noticing something small and finding it perfect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お豆腐、柔らかく煮るのが好きね、あなた。
lines.en: Mm. Soft-simmered tofu—you've always liked it that way.
lines.style: Gentle agreement with a hint of knowing affection. Warm, steady rhythm. The lilt of someone recalling a small, cherished habit. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年取って、一度に食べる量、減ったな。
lines.en: Getting older, I suppose—I can't eat as much at once anymore.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment, not complaint. Slight exhale partway through. Measured pace with a trailing thought. The acceptance in his voice is complete.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お互い、親しい友達、減ってきたわね。
lines.en: We're both noticing it—close friends, they're becoming fewer.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact. No sadness in the delivery, just clarity. Spoken as observation between two people who have lived long enough to understand this without needing comfort.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今日、半日、散歩で疲れた。
lines.en: Just a half-day walk today, and it tired me out.
lines.style: Simple statement, slightly surprised by his own weariness. Gentle acceptance. The voice of someone noticing his body's new limits without bitterness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Practical care with undercurrent of relief. Brisk, attentive. The voice of someone checking in on what matters most, and finding it well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 夏は、暑さで倒れる人、増えるな。
lines.en: More people collapse from the heat in summer. It's becoming more common.
lines.style: Observational, slightly concerned. Steady, measured delivery. Speaking from experience—he's noticed this pattern over years. Not alarmist, just aware.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 長年連れ添って、別れる予定、ないわよ。
lines.en: After all these years together, I've no plans to say goodbye.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Warm and direct, without sentimentality. The kind of statement that needs no flourish. Simply spoken as fact.
